title_sq: Astir ne rruge kryesore shitet ambient biznesi
description_sq:
Ne Astir te rrethrotullimi ne rruge kryesore shitet ambient komercial, ne kat 0 dhe kat 1 me siperfaqe Neto 454 m2 dhe 498 m2 BRUTO me Hipotek. Ambienti eshte i organizuar ne 2 kate (dublex) open spase me fasade xhami, lartesi 3.3 metra me pamje nga rruga kryesore dhe brenda pallatit. Dy katet mund te funksionojne dhe te ndara nga njeri tjetri pasi kane hyrje te dedikuara secila.Ka fasade te gjere xhami ç’ka e ben optimal per reklamimin e biznesit. Aktualisht e dhene me qira. E pershtatshme per Klinika mjekesore/dentare, zyra, palester ose tipologji te ndryshme biznesi.
Per me shume informacion kontakto.
title_en: Astir, on the main road, business premises are for sale
description_en: In Astir, at the roundabout on the main road, commercial premises are for sale, on the 0th and 1st floors, with a net area of ​​454 m2 and a gross area of ​​498 m2 with a mortgage. The environment is organized in 2 floors (duplex) open space with glass facade, height 3.3 meters with a view from the main street and inside the building. The two floors can function separately from each other as they each have dedicated entrances. There are wide glass facades, which makes it optimal for business advertising. It is currently rented out. Suitable for medical/dental clinics, offices, gyms or different types of business. For more information, contact.
